proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5300 jyotis gives Prakrit jōi light/fire and Oriya joe/joi/jui fire. Bhatri and Adivasi Oriya joy/zoi/jai fit this eastern oi-family, retaining affricate/fricative and vowel notation. These forms are compared specifically with the Oriya series; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: zoi.
